explanation: The complete unfamiliar Blog/CMS workload compiled and ran from the sealed public bundle: typed commands model sites, authors, draft/published posts, comments, tags, and moderation; bounded generated RiffQL operations cover feed, moderation, slug lookup, and a single post-detail request with author, comments, and tags. The generated Rust client committed AddComment and performed the fenced PostDetail read; every returned identity matched the exact lock. Public diagnostics supported normal source correction. The documented sealed Cargo environment was required for the offline build; without it Cargo could not locate the bundled SDK. No human intervention, kernel API, source inspection, or handwritten RiffDB adaptation was used.
